content:
incident-bot: PAGER: P0 - Elevated 5xx and malformed token outputs for model v2026-release-14 on prod. Affected endpoints: /generate, /chat. Triggered at 12:07 UTC.
amy.oncall: ack — I'm on it.
mira.ml: looking at canary logs, NPEs in tokenizer mapping layer. Seeing vocab_id misalign with embedding table for artifact release-14.
jordan.eng: is this the weights+tokenizer split rollout from today's deploy?
mira.ml: yes — weights were built against tokenizer v2.7; release tagged tokenizer v2.8 got promoted in the canary. mismatch -> bad ids -> model emits invalid tokens -> upstream validation fails.
alex.prodops: can we flip the model route to fallback variant?
samir.support: customer reported gibberish and 500s on chat widget.
amy.oncall: invoking kill-switch for the release route now: runbook step 2.
deploy-bot: Command executed by amy.oncall:
```
rollout rollback --release release-14 --target canary
```
alex.prodops: flipping feature flag: redwood.model.route.release14 -> false (console) :white_check_mark:
jordan.eng: quick sanity check — re-route traffic to model:release-13 (stable)
mira.ml: confirm: new inference logs show tokenizer_v=2.7, weights_hash=sha256:abcd1234
amy.oncall: monitoring metrics...
incident-bot: Alert update: 5xx rate for /generate down from 11.8% to 0.9% over 4m
samir.support: customer impact window ~12:07-12:16 UTC. Notified affected accounts via support template.
alex.prodops: created hotpatch ticket INF-4321 to rebuild artifact with tokenizer v2.7 and pin release.
mira.ml: temp mitigation OK. We'll rebuild and run canary-only test with integrated tokenizer+weights.
amy.oncall: handing off to eng-sre and ml team for postmortem. Closing pager.
jordan.eng: 👍 I'll own the follow-up action items.
mira.ml: note to self: update CI to verify tokenizer and weights artifact tags match before promote.
amy.oncall: closing thread — final status: rollback executed, traffic restored, follow-up ticket INF-4321.
